windowTreatment.recommendation: Ivory sheers + fully closing oatmeal blackout-lined curtains
windowTreatment.coverage: Full four-sash rear window group. Coordinate the open retreat as part of the same sleep-darkening zone.
windowTreatment.why: The primary bedroom needs sleeping darkness, daytime rest and evening privacy. Treating only this room would leave light entering through the open retreat.
windowTreatment.day: Sheers filter daylight; blackout layer stacks clear.
windowTreatment.night: Close both bedroom and retreat blackout layers; switch off decorative under-bed lighting for sleep if preferred.
windowTreatment.installation: Use independent tracks with overlap/returns. Check the dresser below the window before deciding curtain drop and stack. If it prevents full closure, use a blackout roller behind the sheers rather than trapping fabric behind furniture. Inspect all light gaps after installation.
